data.name: Gioriel
data.gender_notes: Gioriel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, the name Gioriel comes from the words 'Yah' (meaning 'God') and 'Rol' (meaning 'mountain'). This name emphasizes the idea that God is our rock and our refuge, our fortress and our stronghold. The name Gioriel is a reminder that, just as a mountain is a stable and unmovable presence in the landscape, so too is God our constant and unchanging source of strength and support.
data.etymology: Gioriel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is my mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gioriel total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_greek.name: Γιορίελ
in_greek.long_meaning: το όνομα Γιορίελ είναι εβραϊκό και σημαίνει ο Θεός αποκαλύπτεται εν εμοί, και αποτελείται από τις λέξεις γιορ και ιελ, που συμβολίζουν την αποκάλυψη του Θεού στη ζωή του ανθρώπου, και βρίσκεται σε χρήση στην χριστιανική παράδοση

in_latin.name: Gioriel
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen Gioriel est Hebraicum, quod significat Deus revelatur in me, et constat ex verbis gior et el, quae symbolizant revelationem Dei in vita hominis, et invenitur in usu in traditione Christiana

in_english.name: Gioriel
in_english.long_meaning: the name Gioriel is of Hebrew origin, meaning God reveals himself in me, and is composed of the words gior and el, symbolizing the revelation of God in human life, and is found in use in Christian tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name Gioriel is a unique and beautiful Christian name that brings to mind the power and stability of God. It is a name that stands out and is sure to leave a lasting impression.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Gioriel encourages us to remember that, no matter what challenges we face in life, we can always turn to God for strength and support. It reminds us that He is our rock and our refuge, and that He will always be there for us, steadfast and unchanging. This name is a powerful reminder of the power and faithfulness of God, and is a source of comfort and inspiration to those who bear it.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Gioriel: Radiant and pure light of God, bringing hope and transformation. A beacon of divine grace and love.

biblical_reference.note: not a direct biblical name but derived from Hebrew roots

historical_references.reference: In medieval legend, Gioriel was a Christian demon or evil spirit, believed to tempt and torment the faithful, particularly during the hours of darkness.
According to some early Christian texts, Gioriel was a fallen angel, once among the seraphim, who led a rebellion against God. The name is mentioned in the Pseudo-Clementine Recognitions.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Gioriel continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Peter Gioriel from Rome, Italy embodies the meaning of Gioriel - "God is my mountain". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
